Formulation  
Patient presents with acute onset of persistent dizziness, nausea, and imbalance characterized by vertigo symptoms ongoing for two hours, with a similar shorter episode one month prior. History of premature ovarian failure and HRT use noted. No features suggestive of infection or neurological deficit. Likely vestibular origin (labyrinthitis provisional diagnosis). No mental health diagnosis or symptoms explicitly documented. Presentation influenced by physical health condition requiring further examination. Protective factors include supportive spouse and ability to seek help.

- Actions (Clinician/GP): Provide vestibular medication for symptomatic relief; arrange follow-up appointment for clinical examination of ears and neurological status; educate patient on warning signs requiring urgent care.
